section.title: Safety information on patient transport and positioning
section.hierarchy_path: /Safety information/Safety information on patient transport and positioning

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: 2.3 Safety information on patient transport and positioning
For safe and secure patient transport and patient positioning, observe the following sections depending on your workflow.
WARNING
Incorrect patient positioning, unintended patient movement, and unobserved movement of the patient table or gantry!
Injury to the patient, for example, contusions of the patient's extremities and unusable radiation.
◆ Always fix the patient with accessories, as described in the instructions for use, to avoid unintentional patient movement. For example, use restraint straps and arm supports.

◆ Monitor the patient continuously as long as the table top and gantry are moving. Take special care if the tilt of the gantry is anything other than zero degrees or the table height is anything other than the isocenter.

◆ Make sure that nothing can get caught while the table or gantry are moving. For example, parts of the body or clothing, any needles, infusion tubes, respiration tubes, catheters, ECG cables, or sheets and blankets.
◆ Follow the markings and labels on the equipment.
◆ Press a STOP key if an injury to the patient can occur.
WARNING
Incorrect patient positioning!
Injury to the patient or personnel, and damage to the equipment.
◆ Always verify that the patient is correctly positioned.
◆ Always observe the patient during system movements.
SOMATOM | syngo CT VB30
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02
2 Safety information
WARNING
Incorrect patient positioning!
Injury to the patient by moving parts.
◆ Make sure that neither the patient's clothing nor hair can get caught in mechanical parts.

◆ Make sure that infusion lines and respiration tubes, catheters and ECG cables cannot get caught in the space between the table top and the side parts. These components must not be put under tensile stress in any other way.
◆ Make sure that patient bedding cannot get caught by moving parts of the patient table.
◆ Use positioning aids as described.
The patient table and accessories are designed for certain maximum loads.
WARNING
Exceeding the maximum load of the equipment, for example, patient table, overlays, accessories, and the assembly of accessories!
Injury to the patient or the personnel, or damage to the equipment.
◆ Make sure that the permissible maximum load of the equipment is not exceeded. The permissible maximum load of the equipment is displayed on the applied labels.
◆ Verify that the permissible maximum load is not exceeded for:
Each single item of equipment applied or plugged into the patient table. For example, positioning aids and overlays.
Equipment to which other equipment is attached. For example, accessory rail or infusion bottle holder.
The patient must always be positioned on the patient table.
Never position the patient directly in the gantry!

section.title: Trolley
section.hierarchy_path: /Safety information/Safety information on patient transport and positioning/Accessories/Patient transport (CARE TransX)/Trolley

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: Trolley
CAUTION
Overload of the trolley!
Breakdown of the trolley.
◆ Always observe the permissible maximum load of the patient trolley.
CAUTION
Arms, legs or hairs are hanging down at the sides of the trolley!
Injury to the patient.
◆ Make sure that neither the patient's arms, legs nor hair can hang down at the sides.
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02
SOMATOM | syngo CT VB30 36
2 Safety information
WARNING
The patient is not fixed correctly with the restraint straps!
The patient may fall off the trolley.
◆ Always firmly close the restraint straps to prevent the patient from falling off the trolley.
WARNING
Faulty patient positioning using the CARE TransX trolley!
The patient may fall off the trolley.

◆ Before transferring the patient between trolley and table, always make sure that the caster brakes are locked to render the trolley immobile, and that the table top is exactly level with the trolley stretcher top at the outwards end position to avoid collision.
◆ Make sure that any infusion tubes are not squeezed or displaced during the transfer procedure.
◆ Also make sure that patient hair does not become entangled.
◆ Position the CARE TransX stretcher in a way that it is centered about the longitudinal axis of the table top and cannot hang over at the foot end or the head end.
Take care when lowering the patient table to avoid damage to the surgical rail. Remove accessories, for example, trolleys or carts, under the patient table.

◆ Use the released equipment exclusively for its original purpose.
◆ Always follow the instructions for use of the particular units used. This includes the labels applied on to the equipment as well as the instructions for use documents.
WARNING
Incorrect use and use of non-original and non-released equipment!
Injury to the patient and personnel or damage to the equipment. Image quality may also decrease.

◆ Use only the original accessories and equipment or equipment that is released by Siemens Healthineers. This includes, for example, phantoms, footswitches, ECG-cables, positioning aids, or table extensions.

◆ Make sure that the permissible maximum load of the equipment is not exceeded. The permissible maximum load of the equipment is displayed on the applied labels.
◆ Verify that the permissible maximum load is not exceeded for:

Injury to the patient, the personnel, or other persons.

Maximum load label
The maximum permissible load must not exceed 25 kg (55 lbs), which is approximately 245 N.

section.title: Monitor ceiling system
section.hierarchy_path: /Safety information/Safety information on patient transport and positioning/Accessories/Furniture/Monitor ceiling system

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: Monitor ceiling system
Observe the following safety information when using the monitor ceiling system.
WARNING
Liquids in the monitor ceiling system, power supply cables are laid inside!
Electric shock
◆ Make sure that no liquids, for example cleaning fluids, can get into the interior of the monitor ceiling system.
WARNING
Cleaning and disinfection of parts of the system while the system is connected to the power supply!
Electric shock due to possible contact with line voltage.
◆ Always switch the system off at the main power switch before cleaning and disinfecting.
CAUTION
Raising and moving the monitor ceiling system!
Damage to the monitor ceiling system.
◆ Do not use force when moving the device into the limit positions.
◆ Make sure that the monitor ceiling system does not collide with other components.
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02
SOMATOM | syngo CT VB30 46
2 Safety information
CAUTION
Dirt and liquid in the monitor arm of the ceiling mounted monitor!
Infection possible
◆ Clean the monitor and monitor arm after use.
CAUTION
Raising and moving the monitor ceiling system!
Injury to the personnel, damage to monitor ceiling system.
◆ Do not use force when moving the device into the limit positions.Make sure that the ceiling system does not collide with other components.
WARNING
Malfunction of the system or the equipment!
Injury to the patient or personnel, unintended radiation exposure or damage to the equipment.
◆ Press a STOP key at any unintentional system movement and in any hazardous situation.
◆ Press an EMERGENCY OFF key if the system does not respond to the STOP keys in any hazardous situation.
◆ Shut down the system immediately if system malfunctions are detected and notify the Customer Service at Siemens Healthineers.

Observe the following safety information when using the Turbo Flash mode.
WARNING
Weight limitation for Turbo Flash mode. Blocking scan due to exceeding the maximum load!
No scan in Turbo Flash mode possible.
◆ Check the maximum weight of the patient and the accessories, before positioning the patient.
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02

WARNING
Short period of time to press the STOP key due to high table speed!
Contusions of the patient's body. Extractions of infusion lines or needles.
◆ Perform a test run of the table movement to ensure a risk free movement during Turbo Flash Spiral.

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: 2.4 Safety information on patients with implanted devices
Observe the following safety information when examining patients with implanted devices.
WARNING
Rate meters may continue to count the pacemaker rate during occurrences of cardiac arrest or arrhythmia!
ECG leads to wrong diagnosis.
◆ Keep pacemaker patients under close surveillance.
CAUTION
Scanning patients with implanted devices such as pacemakers or neuro stimulators!
Interferences may cause malfunctions of the implanted device.
◆ Observe the patient closely during examination.
Contact the manufacturer of the active implanted device for more information.

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: 2.5.6 Additional information on contrast examinations
Observe the following safety information when performing a contrast examination.
CAUTION
Unintended activation of coupled mode!
Undesired radiation
◆ Verify that uncoupled mode is activated before starting the injection.
CAUTION
Misunderstanding of reference point for start delay in bolus examination!
Faulty synchronization between bolus and scanning.
◆ Make sure that the chosen delay time fits to the characteristics of the bolus injection.
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02
SOMATOM | syngo CT VB30 58
2 Safety information
CAUTION
Scanning with uncoupled contrast medium injection but coupled mode is expected!
Contrast medium not usable.
◆ Before starting the injection, verify that coupled mode is activated.
◆ Follow the Instructions for Use of your bolus injector.
CAUTION
Wrong start delay!
X-ray not, or only partially, usable.
◆ For acquisition with contrast medium, select the flooding time of the contrast medium as the delay.
CAUTION
Required injection protocol on the injector and the CT scanner do not match for the planned scan!
X-ray not, or only partially, usable.
◆ Before performing the coupled scan, verify that the:
Correct injection protocol has been transferred to the CT scanner and that it matches the injection protocol on the injector.
Patient data, contrast media parameters, and scan parameters are correct on the injector and the CT scanner.
Correct injection protocol has been selected when bringing the injector in the Ready status to start.
CAUTION
Injection stopped at the injector by the user without suspending the scan!
X-ray not, or only partially, usable.
◆ Press Suspend at scanner if not enough contrast media was administered.
◆ Stopping the injection at the injector does not stop automatically the scan.
CAUTION
Coupled start is not activated!
Injection will not be started automatically, if coupled start is not activated.
◆ Check in Scan subtask card whether a coupled start is activated or not.
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02
SOMATOM | syngo CT VB30 59

semantic_nodes.canonical_text: 2.8.3 Evaluating pixels with the pixel lens
CAUTION
The pixel lens has a constant size and is independent of the zoom factor of the image!
Wrong diagnosis due to misleading image information.
◆ Please note that the pixel lens is only a pointer indicating the position (not the size) of the measured area.
Force / Force Velo | Instructions for Use Print No. C2-058-C.621.01.01.02
SOMATOM | syngo CT VB30 65
2 Safety information
CAUTION
Use of pixel lens in the Viewing task card and in the 3D task card!
The pixel lens may display different values.

◆ Be aware of differences in pixel lens measurements. The pixel lens measurement in the Viewing task card considers a rectangle around the clicked point, whereas measurement in the 3D task card considers a cube surrounding the clicked point.
